📚 ZenScript: Transform Your Screen Time into Reading Time 📖

Struggling with social media? Endless scrolling eating your time? ZenScript is the mindful reading app that helps you break free from doom scrolling and build healthy reading habits.

★ HOW ZENSCRIPT WORKS ★
✓ Set daily limits for social media apps (Reels, Shorts, feeds)
✓ When you exceed limits, ZenScript blocks distracting apps automatically
✓ Every blocked app attempt opens your current book instead - turning impulse scrolling into reading moments
 ✓ Studying for exams? Upload your PDF textbooks, notes, or assignments - blocked apps will open your study materials instead

📖 KEY FEATURES - MINDFUL READING & DIGITAL WELLBEING 📖

🛡️ SMART APP BLOCKER & SCREEN TIME CONTROL
• Block social media apps when you've scrolled too much
• Set custom time limits for any distracting app
• Screen time tracker shows your daily app usage
• App usage monitor with detailed statistics

📚 EBOOK READER 
• Read books offline - no internet needed after download
• Free classic literature from Project Gutenberg
• EPUB reader with customizable fonts and themes
• Night mode for comfortable evening reading
• Reading progress tracker and bookmarks
• Search free books by title, author, or genre

🌿 DIGITAL WELLBEING & MINDFULNESS
• Replace doom scrolling with meaningful content
• Reduce screen time on unproductive apps
• Build healthy phone usage habits

★ PERFECT FOR ★
✓ Students wanting to focus on studies
✓ Professionals reducing work distractions
✓ Parents setting healthy examples
✓ Book lovers seeking free reading material
✓ People pursuing digital minimalism

★ WHY CHOOSE ZENSCRIPT? ★
Unlike harsh app blockers that just restrict access, ZenScript provides a positive alternative. When you hit your social media limits, we don't leave you hanging - we offer an enriching library of books to explore instead.

Download ZenScript today and:
• Break free from endless scrolling
• Rediscover the joy of reading
• Improve focus and concentration
• Reduce anxiety from social media
• Build lasting mindful habits

🔒 PRIVACY FIRST:
• No account required
• All data stays on your device
• No tracking or ads

Download ZenScript now and turn your phone from a distraction device into a learning tool. Your future self will thank you!

show_hn.title: Show HN: When you open Instagram, your textbook opens instead – ZenScript App

quotes.text:
ZenScript is an Android app that automatically redirects social media apps to your chosen reading material when you hit your daily time limits. Instead of showing a "blocked" screen, it seamlessly opens your ebook or textbook.

Built this after my wife and I kept getting distracted from German exam prep by endless scrolling. We tried every app blocker, but they all had friction - you'd see "blocked" and then manually have to open your study materials, which often broke our motivation.

The key insight: replace the habit rather than just block it. When you tap Instagram after your 30-minute limit, ZenScript intercepts the launch and opens your focus book instead. No friction, just automatic redirection from scrolling to learning.

https://www.zenscript.app/
